adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when `topic_id` is found it directly does `TopicView.new(topic_id, current_user, {best: 5})` with `current_user` potentially `nil` (anonymous) and without any explicit authorization/visibility check in this controller (the only gate shown is `ensure_embeddable`, which validates the referer host and sets `X-Frame-Options`). Whether restricted topics can actually be exposed depends on `TopicView`/downstream guardian enforcement, which is not shown in the diff, so the security impact can’t be verified here—but the lack of an explicit check in the newly added embed endpoint is a concrete, diff-grounded concern.
